tradition.name: Swazi Traditional
tradition.lineage: Swazi traditional music sustains communal song, dance and ceremonial life in Eswatini. Royal-village repertoires, regimental songs and women’s seasonal celebrations connect musical participation with social memory, public honor and the agricultural calendar.

extras.description: Shared melodies and coordinated vocal entries accompany public dancing and collective celebration. Songs can affirm community ties, honor royalty and mark seasonal ceremonies; male, female and mixed groups maintain different repertories within the wider tradition.
exemplars: Women and men of the Queen Mother’s Village
